_note: How hunters, bots and remote players use the stairs, ladders and drops of the continuous levels (hunters/flight_edges.rs). ladder_speed_scale multiplies the climb speed of a ladder (vertical.rs LADDER_CLIMB_SPEED, m/s). drop_allowed lets a hunter jump down a drop (waterfall or hole); one way, off by default. drop_fall_speed is the speed of that fall in m/s. edge_cost_scale (at least 1) multiplies the path cost of a flight, a ladder or a drop. reference_speed is the hunter walk speed in m/s that turns a ladder climb time into a path cost. hear_adjacent_scale is the factor on a sound's radius when it is one storey away (0 = not heard). see_adjacent lets a hunter see a target one storey away through an open well. capture_height is the largest height difference in metres at which a hunter captures. same_layer_eps (0.1 to 2.0) is the largest height difference in metres at which a hunter and a target stand on the same layer (the same floor or deck), so the hunter may dash straight at it; a runner on a catwalk deck above the floor is another layer. catwalk_ladder_enabled and catwalk_jump_enabled switch the two kinds of edge between the floor and a catwalk deck (the ladder at a catwalk link, the jump down off a deck edge; who may use them is data/hunters/decks.json). jump_extra_cost (0 to 50, in cells) is added to a jump's cost so a jump wins only when the ladder is that much further. jump_max_drop_m (0.5 to 10) is the highest deck a hunter jumps from. jump_gravity (m/s squared, 1 to 30), jump_arc_reach_m (how far the arc carries past the deck edge) and jump_arc_samples (3 to 16 points of the arc) shape the fall. edge_enter_radius is how close in metres a hunter must be to the entrance of an edge to start walking it. edge_fit_radius is the body radius in metres of the footprint test while walking an edge (the runner's radius, because the routes of the flights are validated for it; the wider hunter body would stall at the tight turn of a mid landing). edge_stuck_seconds is how long a hunter or bot may fail to progress on an edge before it replans. resident_hunter_cap is how many hunters a resident floor beside the active one simulates.
